note: Forward predictions for 1.18, authored by the pred-scout-coach agent on session compute (no API) and grounded in the 2026-11-02 baseline: pred.gg ranked lane stats for the patch 1.17 family (version ids 167+168+169, ~198,150 matches) and the 1.17.2 public match stream perk counts (augments and Eternals), plus 1.17.2 Eternal usage and finished-item samples. Forecasts, not measured results; no 1.18 games have been counted. Kaelen has no data at all and is absent from data/catalog until pred.gg publishes 1.18, so his entry is a kit-only read. The kit-math sim was not used.

kaelen.name: Kaelen
changes: NEW HERO, melee physical frontliner. 695 health (+131), 310 mana (+60), 65 physical power (+5.2), 135 attack speed (+2.2), 36 physical armor (+4.8), 31 magical armor (+1.7), 700 movement speed, BAT 1.5.
Heart of Ice (passive): abilities leave Rimeglass for 6s. Enemies on it get Frostbite for 1s: 15% slow and 0.5% max health true damage every 0.5s.
Pale Twins (basic): melee, 325u range, 25% cleave, 65 (+80% bonus physical power).

Razorstorm (primary): spins for 3.5s, hitting every 0.25s in 400u for 7.5-17.5 (+8-16% total physical power) (+0.5-1.8% max health), laying Rimeglass. Cannot be interrupted by hard crowd control. 60% against minions. Passively +4-12% armors, x1.5 on Rimeglass. 13-8s cooldown.

Winter's Pursuit (secondary): 1100u dash that stops past the first hero, 70-170 (+100% bonus physical power) and a 25% slow for 1.2s; against a Frostbitten target damage doubles and heroes are rooted for 1.2s instead. 16-14s cooldown.
Rimefang (alternate): 0.6s channel, then a spirit flies 2250u through terrain dealing 11-15% of the target's max health, a 0.2s stun and a 50% slow for 1.5s, trailing Rimeglass. 15-13s cooldown.

Frostfall (ultimate): 1.5s channel, then 4s in the sky at 1275 movement speed, over walls and immune to damage; lands for 200/300/400 (+100% bonus physical power) (+6% bonus health), a 40% slow, a 1.5s root in the center, and an 8s Frost Storm that keeps applying Frostbite at double damage. 130/110/90s cooldown.

Augments: Relentless Hunt (Razorstorm hits once more per 20% attack speed, up to +10, and can crit; Rimeglass no longer grants armor), Neverending Chase (hits on heroes and camp leaders cut Winter's Pursuit cooldown 3%), Last Winter (allies in the landing zone get +20% movement speed; Kaelen gets a 10% max health +4% per hero hit shield).
kaelen.why: Every ability lays Rimeglass, whose Frostbite slows 15% and deals 0.5% max health true damage every 0.5s. Winter's Pursuit roots Frostbitten targets for 1.2s; Frostfall's landing roots the center for 1.5s.
kaelen.willChange: Expect him in many early drafts while players learn him. We hold no data on him, so this is a kit-only read, including the offlane role; the notes call him a frontliner and name Forticus for him. Against him, stay off Rimeglass: Frostbite lingers 1s after you leave it, and Winter's Pursuit roots Frostbitten targets.

valmont.name: Baron Valmont
changes: Hemophagia mana restore 3-38 -> 3-33
Rupture magical power scaling 15% -> 16%
Exsanguinate damage 40/65/90 -> 40/62/84, scaling 23% -> 20%; hero healing 20/40/60 -> 16/34/52, scaling 22% -> 20%
Exsanguinate minion healing modifier 10% -> 12.5%, minion healing 1.8/3.6/5.4 -> 2/4.25/6.5, scaling 2.2% -> 2.5%
Sanguine Banquet omnivamp bonus mana scaling 0.4% -> 0.35%
valmont.why: Exsanguinate's damage drops from 40/65/90 to 40/62/84 and its hero healing from 20/40/60 to 16/34/52. His passive mana restore falls from 3-38 to 3-33.
valmont.willChange: Expect another step down, mostly in long fights the ultimate used to win on its own. He sat at 51.3% over 5,338 midlane games in the 1.17.2 match stream. Open with Rupture and basic attacks before pressing Exsanguinate instead of using the ultimate to walk in.

maco.name: Maco
changes: Health regen 1.6 -> 1.3; attack speed 115 -> 125; BAT 1.3 -> 1.45
Maco Gift! health magical power scaling 35% -> 40%; healing allies now grants Maco the assist
Maco Fly! shield 60/115/170/225/280 -> 60/110/160/210/260, magical power scaling 50% -> 60%
Maco Sparkle! stun 1.1-1.3s -> 1-1.2s, minimum stun 0.5s -> 0.35s
Shatterbloom healing magical power scaling 4% -> 4.5%; Ferocious Flight shield scaling 12% -> 15%, cooldown refund 1s -> 1.5s
maco.why: Maco Gift! healing scaling rises from 35% to 40% and Maco Fly!'s shield scaling from 50% to 60%, but its flat shield drops. Maco Sparkle!'s stun shortens to 1-1.2s.
maco.willChange: Expect a modest climb for magical power healing and shield builds, while the shorter stun makes stun-into-ultimate less reliable. He sat at 47.0% over 11,534 ranked support games. The notes move his value into magical power.

skylar.name: Skylar
changes: Plasma Grenade slow 40-60% -> 45-65%
Air Assault missile scaling 20% bonus physical -> 16%, 12% magical -> 10%; cooldown 24/22/20/18/16 -> 21/19.75/18.5/17.25/16
Hypercharge bonus physical armor penetration 20% -> 25%; damage ramp per hit 1% -> 0.75%, max stacks 25 -> 30, max ramp 25% -> 22.5%
Plasma Barrage explosion missing health damage 6% -> 7.5%; Atomised Artillery time between shots 0.75s -> 0.65s and now +10 ultimate haste
skylar.why: Air Assault's missiles soften and Hypercharge's ramp tops out lower, but its armor penetration rises from 20% to 25%. Plasma Grenade slows harder; Plasma Barrage and Atomised Artillery get stronger.
skylar.willChange: Expect a sideways move rather than a clear rise: her fly-and-beam pattern loses damage while her grenade and armor penetration make her a better answer to tanks. She sat at 48.2% over 24,091 ranked carry games. Try Plasma Barrage or Atomised Artillery once the site's augment card backs it.

legion.name: Legion
changes: Saturation Charge cooldown 19/18/17/16/15 -> 18/17/16/15/14
Frag Order damage 70/110/150/190/230 -> 80/120/160/200/240; bonus physical scaling 60-80% -> 65-85%; magical scaling 40% -> 60%
Press The Advantage fire rate 12-28% -> 14-30%
Napalm Zone damage 5 -> 7, bonus physical scaling 6% -> 7%
Heavy Caliber damage modifier 310% -> 300%
Bugfix: K-75 Storm Rifle now executes minions at the correct threshold
legion.why: Saturation Charge's cooldown drops to 18/17/16/15/14 and Frag Order's magical scaling rises from 40% to 60%. Press The Advantage fires faster, while Heavy Caliber drops from 310% to 300% damage.
legion.willChange: Expect his early lane to feel safer and his win rate to drift up from an already strong 51.4% over 47,619 ranked carry games. If you are the frontliner into him, Hexbound Bracers now blocks 8 (+1 per level) per basic attack, up from 5 (+1 per level).

kira.name: Kira
changes: Nevermore (passive raven) damage (+7% target's current health) -> 15/30/45/60 by level 1/6/11/16 (+5% target's current health)
Dusk bonus physical power scaling per stack 12% -> 15%
kira.why: Her raven now deals 15/30/45/60 by level plus 5% current health, instead of 7% current health alone, so it hits minions and low-health targets harder. Dusk's scaling rises too.
kira.willChange: Expect a small net gain: the raven helps her lane and Dusk helps her later fights. She sat at 49.1% over 27,660 ranked carry games. Keep Solaris, which drops from 15 to 10 ability haste, while the site's build card still ranks it.

kallari.name: Kallari
changes: Crippling Dagger bonus physical power scaling 85% -> 90%, slow 25% -> 30%
Bugfix: double jump now goes on cooldown if she is interrupted out of it
kallari.why: Crippling Dagger's bonus physical scaling rises from 85% to 90% and its slow from 25% to 30%. Her double jump goes on cooldown if she is interrupted out of it.
kallari.willChange: Expect a small rise at most: a slightly stronger dagger helps poke and set up fights but does not change her all-in. She sat at 46.6% over 12,346 ranked jungle games. Her Eternals split widely, so follow the site's Eternal card rather than an old build.

serath.name: Serath
changes: Physical power growth 2.6 -> 3.3 per level
serath.why: Physical power growth rises from 2.6 to 3.3 per level, and Chastise hits for 80/110/140/170/200 instead of 80/105/130/155/180, so the help lands in the mid game.
serath.willChange: Expect more power per level to let her scale without an early lead and her number to move toward even. She sat at 49.1% over 33,898 ranked jungle games. Her Eternal split is wide, so check the site's Eternal card before copying an old build.

iggy-scorch.name: Iggy & Scorch
changes: Flame Turret takes 2x damage from melee basic attacks, up from 1.7x
iggy-scorch.why: Flame Turret now takes 2x damage from melee basic attacks, up from 1.7x. Nothing else in the kit changes.
iggy-scorch.willChange: Expect his offlane number to come down while midlane, which mostly faces ranged mages, stays about where it was. His offlane sat at 54.4% over 13,954 ranked games. Melee offlaners into him should walk up and hit the turrets, which now fall faster.

morigesh.name: Morigesh
changes: Movement speed 675 -> 670
Cursed Infestation hive damage +12% -> +10%
morigesh.why: Cursed Infestation's hive damage drops from +12% to +10% and her movement speed from 675 to 670, so her wave clear and poke slow and she is easier to catch.
morigesh.willChange: Expect a small dip in both seats. The notes aim at her offlane, where she sat at 53.7% over 7,059 games. As a melee laner into her, press trades now that she is easier to catch.

muriel.name: Muriel
changes: Alacrity shield 80/120/160/200/240 -> 80/115/150/185/220, magical power scaling 50% -> 60%
Reversal of Fortune damage reduction 30% -> 20% (+5% magical power)
muriel.why: Alacrity's flat shield drops to 80/115/150/185/220 while its magical scaling rises from 50% to 60%, and her ultimate's damage reduction changes from a flat 30% to 20% (+5% magical power).
muriel.willChange: Expect her to stay strong with magical power and lose ground on full-tank builds. She sat at 53.0% over 21,847 ranked support games, one of the strongest supports on the board. Buy a couple of magical power items before leaning on Alacrity and the ultimate.

steel.name: Steel
changes: Physical armor 38 -> 35; health regen 2 -> 1.8
Bull Rush bonus health scaling 5% -> 6%
steel.why: His base physical armor drops from 38 to 35 and health regen from 2 to 1.8, so level 1 is easier to punish. Bull Rush gains health scaling.
steel.willChange: Expect duo-lane Steel to slip a little and offlane Steel to hold. He was one of the most played supports at 52.2% over 54,079 ranked games. Into him in the duo lane, trade hard at level 1.

sectionMeta.tldr: 1.18 adds Kaelen, a frontliner with no data yet, plus two frontline items, Forticus and Vortex Stone, and trims the Eternals that handed out free gold, haste and health. Valmont is cut for a second straight patch, Maco, Kallari, Kira, Serath and Legion get help, and Steel's level 1, Muriel's tank builds, Morigesh and Iggy's offlane come down. The ranked split also resets, so expect a noisy first week.
sectionMeta.heroes: Twelve heroes are listed, and the changes mostly follow the measured board. Muriel at 53.0% over 21,847 ranked support games and Valmont at 51.3% over 5,338 midlane games since the 1.17.2 nerf take the clearest cuts, while Maco at 47.0% and Kallari at 46.6% get help. Legion is the exception, buffed from 51.4% over 47,619 carry games. Kaelen arrives with no data at all.
sectionMeta.eternals: Seven Eternals change, mostly removing value the notes call free. Aion's Major falls from 6% to 5% gold from ability damage, on an Eternal that ran in 39,397 ranked games in the 1.17.2 window. Krix's Major drops from 5% to 4% max health, aimed at jungle bruisers. Construct and Phylactery shrink too; Resonant Repair, Cull the Weak and The Maw get small lifts. Let the site's Eternal cards pick replacements.
sectionMeta.items: Forticus and Vortex Stone are new with no field data yet, so treat them as experiments until the site's build cards fill in. Solaris drops from 15 to 10 ability haste, and the notes want it off Eden and Yurei. Timewarp's base mana regen falls from 150% to 125% and Magnify's omnivamp from 10% to 8%. Hexbound Bracers blocks more, Penumbra gets cheaper, and Rebirth's cooldown rises.
sectionMeta.systems: Overclocked is a separate limited-time mode, and none of its hero, item, crest or Eternal numbers apply to ranked. For ranked, this patch's system work is bug fixing.
sectionMeta.ranked: Split 5 ends on release day and everyone re-places, so expect early-split lobbies to be noisy and uneven. Read the first week's results with care.

comps.summary: Expect ranked drafts to lean toward real frontlines: Kaelen, Forticus and Vortex Stone arrive while Eternals that hand out free gold, haste and health shrink. Field data replaces these reads as 1.18 games come in.

shifts.text: Vortex Stone refunds 20% of basic cooldowns when you immobilize a hero, suiting engage supports like Riktor (50.0% over 47,720 ranked support games), and Forticus shields fighters mid-fight. Expect one hard engage plus a fighter in the middle to gain.

shifts.lead: Haste-and-gold mage comps lose their cushion
shifts.text: Aion's gold, Construct, Phylactery and Timewarp's mana regen all come down, so expect farming mids paired with a Timewarp support to scale slower. Mages may need to buy more haste.

shifts.lead: Jungle bruisers re-open the Eternal question
shifts.text: Krix, which ran in 15,513 jungle games at 51.4% in 1.17.2, loses health and Predator strength. Expect bruiser junglers such as Aurora and Rampage to stay in the pool, some on another Eternal; let each hero's Eternal card decide.

shifts.lead: Maco and Muriel lean into magical power
shifts.text: Maco gains healing and shield scaling and Muriel's tank build loses shielding, so both push supports toward magical power. Expect full-tank Muriel to lose ground; build her with magical power, where she should stay strong.

Legion gets an earlier spike, Kira gets flat raven damage, and Skylar trades beam damage for anti-tank tools, while Solaris loses haste. Expect lane bullies to punish the weaker level-1 Steel; frontliners into fast attackers can lean on Hexbound Bracers.
